name: Stage 18: Finnsjön to Ånhammar
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 18, Finnsjön to Ånhammar.
utilities: Official area: Gnesta kommun, Strängnäs kommun.

Finnsjön is an overnight/service node at the stage 17/18 boundary, but the official stage start has no public transport and no parking. Car pickup/dropoff is awkward because of the road barrier context from stage 17 and the tiny 2-3 car Körartorpsvägen pull-off before the barrier.

Ånhammar has official parking behind the wagon sheds; the stage board itself is not the parking point. Brotorp about 1.5 km into Stage 19 is a useful alternate parking/rest access if Ånhammar logistics are awkward.

Public transport is poor at both ends. Nearby bus stops such as Ånhammarsvägen, Byringe, and Dunker kyrka are several kilometres away and should be treated as weak access context rather than convenient trailheads.

Rocklösa gård is an off-route, pre-booked lodging/service option about 4-5 km from Ånhammar with cabins, kitchen, shower, toilet, hiking packages, and possible transfer/pickup arrangements; show it as lodging/logistics rather than trail food.
waterSources: No reliable official potable tap or mapped spring was verified on stage 18. Sörmlandsleden may show a generic water facility icon for the shelter areas, but the text does not identify a potable drinking-water source. An OSM seasonal tap near Ånhammar exists, but treat it as field-check backup only.
Finnsjön, Axsjön, Härbärgssjön, Älgsjön, and Kvarnsjön are natural lake water only; filter/boil/treat and avoid presenting lake access as potable water.
A hiker blog reported finding good water on this day, but without a reliable coordinate; do not add it as a water-source marker yet.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 11 km; Naturkartan lists 10.8 km, a Naturkartan GPX check measured about 10.77 km, local official-GPX-derived linework about 10.36 km, Äventyrligare about 10.75 km, AllTrails about 10.5-10.6 km, and OSM relation 1738986 is topologically correct but has stale distance=12 km while measured member geometry is about 10.769 km.

Route character: mostly production forest and clear-cuts with remote-feeling lake passages, steeper hills in places, Magsjöberget edge, Axsjön, Putbergen old-growth reserve, Härbärgssjön shelter, Gustavsbergsgruvorna, Rotsätter/Bottallen, Älgsjön, Kvarnsjön/Dammstugan, and road walking into Ånhammar.

Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. 2025 comments say fallen trees had been cut, markings and boardwalks were good, the stage was well maintained, and a 2026 AllTrails review also reported very good conditions.

A November 2025 maintainer comment says the trail can be quite wet outside summer and recommends boots. A May 2025 local article described about 300 m of boardwalk work near the Ånhammar direction where old boards were often under water at high flows. Older 2024 overgrowth/fallen-tree reports are likely partly superseded by 2025 clearing notes, but remain useful history for shoulder-season expectations.

Naturkartan Stage 18 GPX and OSM relation 1738986 can be stored Ånhammar-to-Finnsjön even though the official walking direction is Finnsjön-to-Ånhammar; reverse imported geometry if needed. The official-direction OSM member sequence is 291430587, 292086886, 292086894, 292086887, 292086888, 128869450, 292086889, 292086883, 946023062, 69813553, 69787142, 128869451, 128436010; the short Ånhammar connector is legitimate, not a false spur.

Putbergen reserve is stricter than ordinary allemansrätten: no tenting, no fires, no motor vehicles, dogs/pets leashed, no damage to living or dead wood, no disturbance within 100 m of raptor nests, and only limited berry/edible-mushroom collection.
Axsjön is a good rest/view area, but the shelter by Axsjön is private. Do not show it as a public shelter or overnight option.

The strongest overnight nodes are Finnsjön at the start and Härbärgssjön mid-stage. Tenting is explicitly possible northeast of Härbärgssjön shelter by the bathing rock on the island/peninsula, outside Putbergen's no-camping/no-fire rule zone.

Magsjöberget and Putbergen rules differ: Magsjöberget is reserve-edge context with vegetation/deadwood restrictions, old mine/quarry traces, bark-beetle dead-spruce caution, and a limited dead-branch small-fire exception subject to bans/signs, while Putbergen explicitly bans tenting and fires.

Fishing should not be presented as automatically allowed in Finnsjön, Magsjön/Östra Magsjön, Axsjön, Härbärgssjön, Älgsjön, or Kvarnsjön; smaller inland waters generally need a fishing card or landowner/fishing-right permission unless a specific free-fishing rule is verified.
Do not promise trash service on Stage 18 generally. Finnsjön has stage-specific bin/waste context from Stage 17/OSM, but Sörmlandsleden's general guidance is to carry all trash out.

facilities.name: Finnsjön stage start
facilities.description: Official stage start coordinate at the stage 17/18 boundary. No parking or public transport at the start.

facilities.name: Finnsjön shelter
facilities.description: Stage 17/18 boundary shelter with fireplace/grill context, nearby dry toilet, tentable point, and lake access. Shared, first-come, no guaranteed firewood, and secure food/scented items because 2024 overnight reports mention rodents.

facilities.name: Finnsjön fireplace
facilities.description: Fireplace/grill context at Finnsjön shelter. Fire bans override and firewood is not guaranteed.

facilities.name: Finnsjön dry toilet
facilities.description: Mapped/confirmed dry toilet near Finnsjön shelter; official context confirms toilet at the boundary.

facilities.name: Finnsjön tent and lake-water context
facilities.description: Tentable shelter-point context and natural lake water only. Filter/boil/treat any lake water.

facilities.name: Finnsjön / Körartorpsvägen barrier warning
facilities.description: Access warning: Finnsjön is not a normal car pickup/dropoff point because the Kalkbro/Finnsjön forest-road access is gated or blocked to motor traffic, and the barrier may be missing from some map bases. OSM node 834675266 is a Stage 18 gate with foot/bicycle allowed and motor_vehicle=private; official text says only 2-3 cars can stand before the barrier on Körartorpsvägen.

facilities.name: Magsjöberget / Finnsjön view
facilities.description: OSM peak/view context as the route follows Finnsjön toward Magsjöberget and brushes the reserve edge.

facilities.name: Magsjöberget reserve edge
facilities.description: Reserve-edge/corridor context where stage 18 brushes the southern part of Magsjöberget: hilly/blocky forest, mining/charcoal traces, vegetation/deadwood restrictions, and bark-beetle dead-spruce caution. Not the same no-fire/no-camping rule set as Putbergen; follow local signs and fire bans.

facilities.name: Körartorpsvägen tiny barrier pull-off
facilities.description: Approximate access/pull-off context before the private motor-vehicle barrier on Körartorpsvägen; official text says only 2-3 cars can stand before the boom. Exact parking point is not mapped in OSM, so treat this as approximate and do not block the road.

facilities.name: Axsjön rest/viewpoint
facilities.description: Approximate rest/view area by Axsjön where official text describes a good rock/viewpoint on the east side. Natural lake water only; official text warns that the shelter by the lake is private.

facilities.name: Axsjön private shelter warning
facilities.description: OSM maps a shelter here, and older hiker reports suggest damage/burnt remains, but official Sörmlandsleden text explicitly says the Axsjön shelter is private. Do not use as a public shelter.

facilities.name: Putbergen nature reserve rules
facilities.description: Old-growth reserve crossed by the stage's eastern corridor, described by Länsstyrelsen as Sörmland's oldest old-growth forest with very old pines, deadwood, fungi, and storm-felled trunks. No camping, no fires, no motor vehicles, dogs/pets leashed, no damage to living/dead standing or fallen wood, no picking plants except berries, no collecting lichens/fungi except edible mushrooms, and do not disturb wildlife including staying within 100 m of raptor nests.

facilities.name: Putbergen south dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet at the forest-road crossing near Putbergen's southern boundary, not a Länsstyrelsen reserve-service guarantee. OSM and hiker reports place it before Härbärgssjön.

facilities.name: Härbärgssjön shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter after about 5.5 km and the primary mid-stage overnight/rest node. Shelter sources list about 4 sleeping places; shared, first-come, no guaranteed firewood. Hiker reports used it for lunch and fire, including in mosquito/rain conditions.

facilities.name: Härbärgssjön fireplace
facilities.description: Mapped firepit/grill beside the shelter, corroborated by shelter/fireplace sources. This is outside Putbergen's no-fire rule context, but use only when fire bans and local rules allow and do not assume firewood.

facilities.name: Härbärgssjön swim/tent point
facilities.description: Approximate island/peninsula northeast of the shelter where official text says there is a bathing rock and tenting is possible. 2024 hikers described quiet overnighting but stony water edges and brown/humic lake water; avoid fragile shore/reed points and dead-tree hazards. Exact tent/badklippa point still needs field mapping.

facilities.name: Gustavsbergsgruvorna mine shafts
facilities.description: Old mine/heritage cluster after Härbärgssjön; OSM maps several mine-shaft nodes nearby, including points around 59.17358,16.91642 and 59.17389,16.91851. Treat mine holes and remains as safety hazards and protected heritage; do not wander to shaft edges.

facilities.name: Bottallen at Rotsätter
facilities.description: Folk-healing pine/root-opening and former tenant-farm context described by official text and hiker blogs.

facilities.name: Älgsjön rest and natural-water context
facilities.description: Lake/rest context where the stage follows the west side for a few hundred metres. Natural lake water only; not a potable refill.

facilities.name: Kvarnsjön boardwalk
facilities.description: Approximate boardwalk/bay crossing before Dammstugan. A 2025 local article described boardwalk rebuilding toward Ånhammar where old boards were often under water at high flows; wet/off-season conditions can still make boards slippery.

facilities.name: Dammstugan mill
facilities.description: Preserved mill/dam context before Ånhammar; local heritage source says older mill equipment remains in the mill house. Information-board context is nearby around 59.151666,16.917025.

facilities.name: Ånhammar possible seasonal tap
facilities.description: OSM-only seasonal drinking-water tap near Ånhammar. Treat as a field-check backup, not a reliable planned refill.

facilities.name: Ånhammar parking
facilities.description: Official parking/access context behind the wagon sheds/vagnslidren. Do not park at the stage board; follow local signs. Local endpoint linework ends within metres of this coordinate, but exact signed parking entrance still needs field confirmation.

facilities.name: Brotorp alternate parking/rest access
facilities.description: Useful access context about 1.5 km into Stage 19 when Ånhammar logistics are awkward. Officially a good parking/rest area on Stage 19, not a Stage 18 endpoint.

facilities.name: Fishing-permit warning
facilities.description: Stage lakes are water/access context only. Fishing is not automatically included in allemansrätten; verify permits and local rights before fishing.

facilities.name: Ånhammarsvägen weak bus context
facilities.description: Distant access context only: mapped bus-stop pair north of the stage, several kilometres from Finnsjön and much farther from Ånhammar. Do not present as convenient endpoint transit.

facilities.name: Byringe weak bus context
facilities.description: Distant access context only: Länsstyrelsen names Byringe for Magsjöberget access, about 4 km from the reserve, not as a clean Stage 18 endpoint.

facilities.name: Rocklösa gård lodging context
facilities.description: Off-route, paid/pre-booked lodging and hiking-package logistics option about 4-5 km from Ånhammar/stages 18-19 with cabins, kitchen, shower, toilet, and possible transfer/pickup. Verify booking and season before relying on it.
